# Pantry Pal - Product Requirements Document

## Goals and Background Context
Reduce household food waste.

## Functional Requirements

- FR1: Users can add a pantry item with a name, quantity and expiry date.
- FR2: Users can scan a barcode to prefill an item.
- FR3: Users receive a notification two days before an item expires.
- FR4: Users can mark an item as used up.

## Non-Functional Requirements

- NFR1: The item list loads in under 1 second with 500 items.
- NFR2: All data is stored on the device; no account is required.
